pub use std::{boxed, vec};
extern crate alloc as alloc_crate;
mod binary_heap;
mod linked_list;
mod vec_deque;
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::cmp::Ordering;
use std::panic::{AssertUnwindSafe, catch_unwind};
struct Element<'a> {
    n: u32,
    drops: &'a Cell<usize>,
    attempts: &'a Cell<usize>,
    clones: &'a Cell<bool>,
    compares: &'a Cell<bool>,
    bomb: &'a Cell<Option<u32>>,
}
impl PartialEq for Element<'_> {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.n == other.n
    }
}
impl Eq for Element<'_> {}
impl PartialOrd for Element<'_> {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<Ordering> {
        Some(self.cmp(other))
    }
}
impl Ord for Element<'_> {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering {
        if self.compares.replace(false) {
            panic!("comparison");
        }
        self.n.cmp(&other.n)
    }
}
impl Clone for Element<'_> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        let n = self.attempts.get();
        self.attempts.set(n + 1);
        if self.clones.get() && n == 2 {
            panic!("third clone");
        }
        Self {
            n: self.n,
            drops: self.drops,
            attempts: self.attempts,
            clones: self.clones,
            compares: self.compares,
            bomb: self.bomb,
        }
    }
}
impl Drop for Element<'_> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.drops.set(self.drops.get() + 1);
        if self.bomb.get() == Some(self.n) {
            self.bomb.set(None);
            panic!("payload drop");
        }
    }
}
fn main() {
    let drops = Cell::new(0);
    let attempts = Cell::new(0);
    let clones = Cell::new(false);
    let compares = Cell::new(false);
    let bomb = Cell::new(None);
    let make = |n| Element {
        n,
        drops: &drops,
        attempts: &attempts,
        clones: &clones,
        compares: &compares,
        bomb: &bomb,
    };
    {
        let mut heap: binary_heap::BinaryHeap<_> = (0..8).map(&make).collect();
        compares.set(true);
        assert!(
            catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                heap.push(make(20));
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(heap.len(), 9);
        drop(heap);
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 9);
    }
    drops.set(0);
    {
        let mut heap: binary_heap::BinaryHeap<_> = (0..8).map(&make).collect();
        compares.set(true);
        assert!(
            catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                drop(heap.pop());
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(heap.len(), 7);
        drop(heap);
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 8);
    }
    drops.set(0);
    attempts.set(0);
    {
        let list: linked_list::LinkedList<_> = (0..5).map(&make).collect();
        clones.set(true);
        assert!(
            catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                drop(list.clone());
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 2);
        clones.set(false);
        drop(list);
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 7);
    }
    drops.set(0);
    {
        let list: linked_list::LinkedList<_> = (0..5).map(&make).collect();
        bomb.set(Some(2));
        assert!(
            catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                drop(list);
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 5);
    }
    drops.set(0);
    {
        let mut list: linked_list::LinkedList<_> = (0..5).map(&make).collect();
        bomb.set(Some(2));
        assert!(
            catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                list.clear();
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(list.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(list.front().unwrap().n, 3);
        list.push_front(make(9));
        drop(list);
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 6);
    }
    drops.set(0);
    attempts.set(0);
    {
        let queue: vec_deque::VecDeque<_> = (0..5).map(&make).collect();
        clones.set(true);
        assert!(
            catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
                drop(queue.clone());
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 2);
        clones.set(false);
        drop(queue);
        assert_eq!(drops.get(), 7);
    }
    println!("collection panic invariants passed");
}
